title: Platform-specific triggers: FileMaker Go (iOS)
description: Scripts in scope attached to a script-trigger event that fires only in FileMaker Go (iOS) - the AV-player and external-command events - derived from the Claris trigger-compatibility table (fm_spec trigger_compat, fm-spec 2.8.0+) with a strict exclusivity predicate. Inventory, not defects: findings are neutral properties. Complements the step and function evidence of platform_specific_ios.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A trigger that exists only on iOS binds the attached script to FileMaker Go: on every other runtime the event never occurs and the script never runs from it. That is a property of the script, not a defect.
rule.remediation: Nothing to fix. Use the inventory to see the iOS layer of the solution; the other environments' trigger-compatibility members show the same events as 'does not fire'.

defaultResult.name: finding_count
defaultResult.meaning: Scripts in scope attached to iOS-only trigger events
